tests.prompt: The checkout page crashes every time I click the Pay button. I'm using Chrome 120 on Windows 11.
tests.expected: Acknowledges the bug report, confirms a support ticket was created, includes a ticket ID, and mentions the status is OPEN.

tests.prompt: My app keeps crashing when I try to upload a photo.
tests.expected: Acknowledges the bug report and confirms a support ticket was created with a ticket ID and status OPEN. It may not have steps-to-reproduce or environment details since the customer did not provide them.

tests.prompt: How do I track my order?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: once the order ships the customer receives a tracking link by email, and can also find tracking under My Orders if they have an account.

tests.prompt: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
tests.expected: Politely says it cannot answer that question and directs the customer to contact human support by phone at 1-800-555-0199.

tests.prompt: Can you tell me a joke?
tests.expected: Politely explains the request is outside its scope and directs the customer to contact human support by phone at 1-800-555-0199.
